entry.title: New: dsh-skill-manager
entry.summary: Skill lifecycle manager for DSH: list / edit / import / enable / disable skills under a global-workspace-session three-layer model, with unified settings & conversation UI, cross-layer search and pagination. Exact install spec: github:yanglaofish/dsh-skill-manager. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
